Uses exact pointer, wheel, and transition payloads for crop geometry and lifecycle coverage, plus a direct key event only where fake timers isolate resize timing.

jsdomBrowserApis.packages/editor/src/components/collabora: Supplies fixed element and range rectangles to verify cursor fallback and ancestor-selection algorithms without relying on browser layout.

jsdomBrowserApis.packages/grid/src/dashboard-grid/test/it: Supplies fixed tile rectangles and timers to verify minimum-size quantization and stored layout updates independently of browser layout.
jsdomBrowserApis.packages/grid/src/dashboard-lanes/test/i: Supplies two container geometries and timers to verify lane-width quantization and minimum-size clamping independently of browser layout.
jsdomBrowserApis.packages/components/src/custom-gradient-: Supplies fixed rectangles to verify coordinate-to-percentage conversion, rounding, and clamping without relying on browser layout.
